corpus.acquisition_method: commit-pinned raw GitHub URLs (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/<commit>/<path>); no mirror, no mutable branch

labels.bounded_scope: Bounded evaluation over three Python 3.12.13 documentation files and 70 chunks; it does not represent all Python documentation.
labels.diagnostic_only: Generation is deterministic extraction, not an LLM; results are diagnostic, not production readiness.
labels.generation: Offline deterministic extractive evaluation — not an LLM result
labels.live_generation: Live generation NOT measured — no provider/model/credentials are configured and no provider is selected; the offline report covers deterministic extractive generation only.
labels.no_live_claim: Live generation is not measured here: no provider/model/credentials are configured, so no live result exists to report.
labels.non_semantic: Dense mode uses deterministic non-semantic hash embeddings; scores encode token overlap only, not meaning.
labels.separate_from_other_reports: This report is a separate real-local generation evaluation and is never combined with the synthetic, hash-materializer, or semantic materializer reports.

limitations: Bounded evaluation over three Python 3.12.13 documentation files and 70 chunks; it does not represent all Python documentation.
Generation is deterministic extractive/template output, not an LLM result; live generation is NOT measured because no provider/model/credentials are configured.

The claim-support rule is exact normalized containment only: a claim is supported iff its normalized text is a substring of a cited chunk's normalized text. This measures verbatim grounding, not semantic entailment.
Results are diagnostic, not production readiness; no quality claim is made.
No chunk-level or claim-level text is stored in this report; claims carry ids and support verdicts, citations carry excerpt checksums and short prefixes, and abstention details are truncated.
Denominators are small (12 answerable and 6 non-answerable queries); one query moves percentages by up to 8.3 percentage points.
